title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: Experience the full power of Spyglass, now generally available with a suite of features designed to revolutionize your productivity and insights.

title: Advanced File Management & Display Options
summary: Empower your content creation with intuitive new tools for managing, adding, and customizing the display of all your files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Stay informed with our new public roadmap, clearly outlining recently completed updates, what's next, and future plans to enhance your experience.

title: Improved Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a seamless experience with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, more responsive, and easily draggable for enhanced task management.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Experience
summary: We've delivered significant enhancements to ensure working together is more intuitive, efficient, and seamless than ever before.

title: Enhanced Sharing and Collaboration
summary: Empowering seamless collaboration, this update ensures you can easily find and engage with all relevant shared items from your network.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is becoming open source, granting our community unparalleled control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's development.

title: Multilingual Noeko
summary: We are thrilled to introduce robust international language support, empowering users worldwide to experience Noeko seamlessly in their native tongue.

title: Refreshed & Expanded Theme Gallery
summary: Elevate your experience with stunning new themes and significant improvements to our existing visual options, giving you more ways to personalize your workspace.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Effortlessly navigate and discover connections within your knowledge map using new powerful filtering options and improved visibility for shared items.

title: Advanced Search and Personalized Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint specific information within your knowledge base by applying powerful filters and saving your tailored search results as personalized collections for quick access.

title: Interactive Content Previews
summary: We are introducing flexible new ways to display and interact with your linked content, helping you organize your thoughts more intuitively.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosted Freedom and Premium Access
summary: Experience ultimate flexibility with Noeko's new self-hosting option and unlock advanced capabilities with our exciting range of paid plans.

title: Personalized Greetings
summary: Enjoy perfectly timed greetings that genuinely reflect your local time, enhancing your overall experience with our platform.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your content by performing actions like unapplying tags or deleting items directly within the tag view, making organization faster and more intuitive.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a broader range of content, from YouTube videos to websites and text, making it easier than ever to capture all your essential information.
